idea-plugin.name: ReadyStack Warm Dark
idea-plugin.description:
Warm, low-glare dark. Amber on paper-dark; comments recede, keywords lead.

Built from a measured contrast ladder: body text passes WCAG AAA and every accent colour passes AA. The comment colour is deliberately the one thing that recedes; keywords lead in bold.

Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, Rider, CLion and the other IntelliJ-based IDEs.

This is one of twelve themes built to the same standard — eight dark, four light. Get all twelve.

MIT licensed.
